items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Bill Pemberton played bass, of all people... We had a hell of an 8-piece band.

ctx.x: So finally around 1939 or 40, I got a job with Dickie Wells's -- after hours spot didn't start until about 3 or 4 o'clock in the morning, after everything else was closed. So we had quite a bit of downtown trade, plenty. They used to come up and spend all kind of money. And it was with a tramp band, of all things, 8-piece tramp band. No horns, kazooks.

Bill Pemberton played bass, of all people... We had a hell of an 8-piece band. 3 guys Kazooks, sing and you would think it was a whole band up there. And this was in around 1940, the first part of 1940. As of so.
As far as the guitar it was a lucky incident that I learned it. Cause hanging out with fellas that had a group when they had guitars-- tipple. You know what a tipple is?--Ten string guitar.
